movelist.name: Psychic
movelist.effect: The target is Pushed 1 meter in any direction. Psychic lowers the target’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Psych Up
movelist.effect: The user’s Combat Stages are changed to match the target’s Combat Stages. Psych Up cannot miss.

movelist.name: Zen Headbutt
movelist.effect: Zen Headbutt Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Simple Beam
movelist.effect: You choose one of the target’s Abilities. Simple Beam changes that Ability to Simple for the remainder of the encounter.

movelist.name: Imprison
movelist.effect: The target is Locked for the rest of the Scene. A Locked target may not use any Moves the user knows. Imprison cannot miss.

movelist.name: Hidden Power
movelist.effect: When a Pokémon first obtains the Move Hidden Power, roll 1d20. Hidden Power’s Elemental Type will be changed from Normal to Bug on a result of 1; Dark on 2; Dragon on 3; Electric on 4; Fairy on 5; Fighting on 6; Fire on 7; Flying on 8; Ghost on 9; Grass on 10; Ground on 11; Ice on 12; Normal on 13; Poison on 14; Psychic on 15; Rock on 16; Steel on 17; Water on 18; and on 19 or 20, reroll until you roll another number. This effect is permanent –if Hidden Power is forgotten and relearned, the chosen Type remains the same.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. Whenever an Ally uses a damaging area-of-effect attack that would hit you, you may Disengage as a Free Action before the attack resolves.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.trigger: The user is Paralyzed, Frozen, Burned,
abilities.effect: The foe which caused the Status Condition is given the same Status they inflicted.

abilities.name: Probability Control
abilities.effect: The user may reroll any roll, or have any ally reroll any roll that has been made. This leaves discoverable Psychic residue.
